name: page-tint-glows-in-native-view
description: Native app view kept the page's colour off the chrome: the root painted a flat surround, the pane container a second flat fill under the card, and the sidebar document a third, so the edge glow had nowhere to show. Same two declared-colour pages and the same switch as page-tint-glows-through-a-theme, on a flat space with Native app view on. The window now paints the surround with the glow on top, on the root, in the pane container and under the floating panel, and the sidebar document no longer covers it.
